title: The pharmacokinetic property and pharmacological activity of acteoside: A review.
authors: Xiao, Yaosheng; Ren, Qun; Wu, Longhuo
one_liner_zh: 该文综述毛蕊花糖苷的药代动力学与药理活性，仅提及分子对接模拟，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Acteoside (AC), a phenylpropanoid glycoside isolated from many dicotyledonous plants, has been demonstrated various pharmacological activities, including anti-oxidation, anti-inflammation, anti-cancer, neuroprotection, cardiovascular protection, anti-diabetes, bone and cartilage protection, hepatoprotection, and anti-microorganism. However, AC has a poor bioavailability, which can be potentially improved by different strategies. The health-promoting characteristics of AC can be attributed to its mediation in many signaling pathways, such as MAPK, NF-kappaB, PI3K/AKT, TGFbeta/Smad, and AMPK/mTOR. Interestingly, docking simulation study indicates that AC can be an effective candidate to inhibit the activity of SARS-CoV2 main protease and protect against COVID-19. Many clinical trials for AC have been investigated, and it shows great potentials in drug development.
abstract_zh: 毛蕊花糖苷（Acteoside, AC）是一种从多种双子叶植物中分离得到的苯丙素苷，已被证明具有多种药理活性，包括抗氧化、抗炎、抗癌、神经保护、心血管保护、抗糖尿病、骨与软骨保护、肝脏保护以及抗微生物作用。然而，AC的生物利用度较低，可通过不同策略加以改善。AC的健康促进作用归因于其对多种信号通路的调节，如MAPK、NF-kappaB、PI3K/AKT、TGFbeta/Smad和AMPK/mTOR。有趣的是，分子对接模拟研究表明，AC可能是抑制SARS-CoV2主要蛋白酶活性并预防COVID-19的有效候选化合物。针对AC的许多临床试验已开展，其在药物开发中显示出巨大潜力。
